From content to publication

A practical sequence with clear review points.

01

Define the brief

02

Set the direction

Review a cover and representative spread before the full layout.

03

Build the document

Apply the agreed hierarchy and layout system across the publication.

04

Review and hand over

Check the corrections, export the agreed PDFs and package the source files.
